title: Muslim deputation meets Lord Minto
detail: A delegation of Muslim leaders petitioned Viceroy Lord Minto for separate representation and weightage in legislative councils, a demand that became part of the reform debate.

title: Indian Councils Act introduces separate electorates
detail: The Morley–Minto reforms enlarged legislative councils and established separate Muslim electorates. The franchise remained restricted, and the councils did not make the executive responsible to elected representatives.
